## 2025 --- Student projects on food-waste reduction

A Soka University press release describes the Chonabayashi Seminar's AI-assisted food-waste reduction project, which used a points system to encourage cafeteria users to finish their meals. The project was also featured in university press-release coverage distributed through [Okinawa Times](https://www.okinawatimes.co.jp/articles/-/1722393) and [Livedoor News](https://news.livedoor.com/pr_article/detail/30081617/) on November 27, 2025 (in Japanese).

## 2025 --- Yumenavi public lecture

**気温上昇で社会に何が起こる？経済学×データで探る未来**\
What Happens to Society as Temperatures Rise? Exploring the Future through Economics and Data.

気候変動が社会や経済に与える影響について、データと経済学の視点から解説しています。\
This lecture explains how climate change affects society and the economy, using data and perspectives from economics. Recorded in 2025; in Japanese.

[動画 / Watch on Yumenavi](https://douga.yumenavi.info/Lecture/PublishDetail/2024003592) · [関連する短い解説記事 / Related short article](https://yumenavi.info/vue/lecture.html?gnkcd=g015544)

## 2012 --- Tropical cyclone research

[ScienceDaily: Tropical cyclones to cause greater damage, researchers predict](https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2012/02/120201105227.htm), February 1, 2012. Yale School of Forestry & Environmental Studies news release republished by ScienceDaily, covering the coauthored paper "The impact of climate change on global tropical cyclone damage" in *Nature Climate Change*.
